ModMetaData.name: Immersive Raid Compression
ModMetaData.author: lyj
ModMetaData.description:
Reduces oversized late-game threats with stronger vanilla units or two-to-three qualified reinforcement waves, without hidden stat buffs.
Supported families include ordinary human and mechanoid raids, pirate assaults, manhunter packs, mech clusters, ordinary infestations, storyteller Fleshbeast Attacks, and large humanoid, animal, and multi-direction shambler attacks. Every family has dedicated identity-preservation rules. Special strategies, protected units, original structures, arrival behavior, and total combat value are retained or the change is rejected.
Large shambler threats are never converted into ranged gorehulks. The exact vanilla-generated pawns, animals, rare chimeras, equipment, health, lifespan, and total combat power are retained and distributed into two or three substantial waves. Every wave must pass a dynamic point floor. Weak tails are merged, ordinary swarms reuse their original edge area, multi-direction assaults reuse the vanilla distributed edge worker, and reinforcements join the original Lord to inherit its live attack state. Small shambler swarms, ghoul attacks, rituals, quests, and scripted encounters remain vanilla.
The in-game audit page shows classification, before/after composition, retained points, wave sizes, release state, arrival mode, and identity proof.
通过更高价值的原版单位或两至三批达到点数下限的增援，降低后期大型威胁的同时存在单位数，不添加隐藏属性 Buff。
目前覆盖普通人类与机械族袭击、海盗强攻、食人动物群、机械集群、普通虫族感染、叙事者血肉兽袭击，以及大型人形、动物和多方向蹒跚怪袭击。每种威胁都有独立的特征保护规则；特殊策略、受保护单位、原版建筑、入场行为和总战力无法保持时会完整回退原版。
大型蹒跚怪威胁不会被替换成大量远程 Gorehulk。原版实际生成的小人、动物、低概率奇美拉、装备、生命状态、寿命和总战力完全保留，只分配到两批或三批足量部队。每批必须通过动态点数下限，过弱尾批会智能合并。普通尸群复用原地图边缘区域，多方向强攻继续调用原版分散边缘入场 Worker，增援加入原 Lord 并继承其实时进攻状态。小型蹒跚怪群、尸鬼袭击、仪式、任务和脚本遭遇保持原版。
游戏内记录页面会显示分类、压缩前后构成、保留点数、波次数量、释放状态、入场方式及特征保持证明。
